controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p300: 18C deviation (single 12-month disposal undertaking citing Rules 10.07(1)(a), 18C.13 and 18C.14, replacing the standard six-month limb) is correctly captured. DATE CORRECTION: the clause ends 'on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive end ON the anniversary (2027-05-20), so first free = 2027-05-21. Candidate's 2027-05-20 made the anniversary itself the free day.

corrections.basis: Chapter 18C: single 12-month disposal undertaking under Rules 10.07(1)(a), 18C.13 and 18C.14 commencing on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date (inclusive of Listing Date) and ending 'on the date which is 12 months from the Listing Date' (inclusive end ON the anniversary); first free day = anniversary + 1 = 2027-05-21.
